raw_text: The Pune Smart City IoT attack is a case study in what happens when basic security hygiene is ignored. An unauthenticated MQTT broker gave attackers control over 2,000+ streetlights and 150 traffic controllers. This caused real-world harm with rush hour accidents. Every Indian smart city project needs to audit their IoT security immediately. PMC has rightly disconnected everything.
clean_text: Pune IoT attack highlights failure of basic security hygiene. Unauthenticated MQTT broker enabled citywide infrastructure control. Real-world harm from rush hour accidents.
